integrity: The singular locus and local normal forms are proved directly; weighted-homogeneous Milnor/Tjurina and threshold formulas are checked against an exact symbolic verifier. Literature comparisons are limited by indexing and terminology.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the explicit Thom--Sebastiani family of Theorem 1.5; the threshold records only the largest part of the multiplicity partition and need not determine the full partition or projective isomorphism class.
title: Log-canonical thresholds in a Thom–Sebastiani free-curve family
